Where the sign-in lives

These sign-ins live in Chrome and the extension, never in Anteroom, which asks you to sign in again when one expires.

Sale detection

Detect sales checks a few times an hour (Poshmark by comparing your Poshmark closet) and tells you when a listed item sells; nothing comes down unless Delist the other marketplaces is on.

Delist the other marketplaces

When something sells, take it off the other marketplaces it’s still listed on; the sale notice says if a delist can’t finish.

Listing extension folder

In chrome://extensions, turn on Developer mode, click Load unpacked, press ⌘⇧G, paste this path and choose Open.

Remote access
Tailscale HTTPS

Reach this Mac’s Anteroom from your phone over your private tailnet; Funnel stays off.

Enable

Install Tailscale on this Mac and your phone, sign in to the same account, then enable here.
